assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a transparent game sprite atlas referencing the attached Make Believe scene for exact character identity and cartoon rendering. TWO equal side-by-side columns with wide transparent gutter. In BOTH columns draw the same complete cream baby unicorn with pastel pink/lilac/turquoise mane and tail, gold horn and purple hooves, body three-quarter but head looking directly OUT AT VIEWER, friendly female face. Left column both eyes open. Right column EXACT same pose, same outline, size, placement and every body detail, but her viewer-left eye is closed in a playful wink; other eye remains open. Keep body, mane, hooves, tail, head and ears pixel-aligned between the two poses: this is a facial-expression animation, not different body drawings. Complete attached tail and ears, four intact legs, no ground shadows, no scenery, no books, no sparkles or text. Match simple warm dark outlines, glossy soft cartoon shading. Genuine transparent alpha background, no checkerboard painted into art. Center each full unicorn in equal cells and leave safe transparent margins, no cropped body parts.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Transparent game animation PARTS atlas matching the attached Holiday Mixup snowman illustration exactly in rounded warm cartoon style. THREE non-touching columns with wide clear transparent gutters, no text or shadows. LEFT column: the complete happy snowman BODY WITHOUT BOTH STICK ARMS, purple scarf, three buttons, carrot nose looking right, but bunny ears must be a COSTUME HEADBAND: a visible slim purple curved band sitting over his round snow head with two white/pink fabric rabbit ears attached to the band; visible distinction from snow body, not real ears growing out. Body has intact round sides where arms attach. MIDDLE column: ONLY complete viewer-left brown branching stick arm with round full shoulder root on RIGHT end, twig fingers pointing up-left; no snow or scarf fragments. RIGHT column: ONLY complete viewer-right brown branching stick arm with round full shoulder root on LEFT/lower end, twig fingers up-right. Both arms long enough to overlap into the body when assembled, natural branch elbow, rounded outlines, easy to rotate up/down at shoulder. Draw all objects fully and separately on genuine transparent alpha. Match the identity, purple knit scarf, carrot, coal buttons and glossy simple shading of reference. No scenery, gifts, ground or disconnected body fragments.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a transparent animation parts atlas of the attached cute blonde fairy. THREE separate columns, wide transparent gutters. Left: complete fairy BODY, hair, head, pink petal dress, legs, arms, gold star wand as reference, facing RIGHT, but NO WINGS at all. Center: a complete large turquoise/lilac butterfly upper wing and small lower wing joined as ONE wing pair, elongated to upper left with a full rounded root at lower RIGHT. Right: second complete slightly smaller turquoise/lilac wing pair with root at lower RIGHT, to attach behind fairy body on opposite side. No fragments of fairy in wing cells, no wing fragments on fairy body. Match reference clean dark purple warm cartoon outlines, simple glowing pale turquoise translucent-looking wing panels, lilac edges, blonde hair pink flower, expressive cute face. Complete body and complete independent wings, generous root overlap for flapping via hinge rotation. All three objects isolated on genuine alpha transparency, no shadows, scenery, sparkles floating outside, text or labels.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one transparent game TEXTURE atlas for a physically hinged magic spell book matching the purple/gold book in reference. TWO separate flat rectangular panels side by side, same size and aspect 5:3, viewed EXACTLY straight-on/top-down, zero isometric perspective or thickness, no cast shadows. Left panel: purple leather FRONT COVER, rounded rectangular corners, thick golden edge trim, ornate simple gold corner protectors, one raised golden five-point star centered, friendly glossy cartoon shading and warm dark outline matching reference. Right panel: warm ivory INSIDE COVER / exposed first page, same rounded rectangle, thin golden decorative frame and a small simple gold star near center, subtle paper texture but no letters. Fill each panel fully, isolated alpha transparent outside panels with a wide transparent gutter, no spine protrusions, no pages sticking out, no other books, no text. The game will map these flat textures onto real moving 3D planes so correct flat geometry is essential.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONLY a replacement golden gift-box lid with tied golden bow, on transparent alpha, matching the attached Holiday Mixup cartoon scene. It must fit the PURPLE TOP PRESENT of this scene: three-quarter isometric box, front-left broad face and right narrow face, top diamond/parallelogram, camera slightly above. A thin clean golden LID CAP, not another box. Bow attached on top. Solid flat closed underside, absolutely NO inverted pyramid, pointed protrusion, pedestal, bottom foot, dangling ribbon loops or black underside lump. Lid edge is shallow with an ordinary flat lower rim; in silhouette the lower edge follows a simple shallow gift-lid corner. Thin enough to lift and show a turkey underneath. Match warm outlines, bright glossy yellow/gold highlights and simple illustration style. Whole complete lid and whole bow with generous transparent margin, no ground shadow, no present body, no other objects, text or background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single cute LIVING Thanksgiving turkey character for a surprise popping out of a holiday gift. Full complete bird on genuine alpha transparent background, no gift box. Friendly front-facing round brown turkey, big kind eyes, small golden beak and red wattle, spread fan of 5 simple warm orange/gold/red tail feathers, two small wings slightly lifted as if saying hello, tiny feet. Match the attached Holiday Mixup game's clean warm outlines, soft glossy cartoon shading, rounded shapes and simple playful family-friendly style. No hat, props, writing, ground shadow or scenery. Bird must read instantly at small phone size, no realistic feather detail. Complete head and tail feathers with safe transparent margin.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single large soft pastel rainbow arch for the background sky of the attached Holiday Mixup cartoon mobile game. Transparent alpha all around and throughout the open center below the arch, NO sky rectangle. Wide shallow semicircular rainbow, seven clear soft bands warm coral, peach, yellow, light green, turquoise, sky blue, lilac; soft lightly painted edges in the same clean simple cheerful cartoon style as reference. Endpoints lightly feathered, no clouds attached, no stars, no sun, no characters, snow or scenery, no text. Bright enough to be visible against cyan sky but gentle, beautiful and unobtrusive. Complete arch with generous transparent margin. This will be placed behind snowman and gifts and slowly faded in/out.

Create a transparent game animation atlas of this same fairy and two separate wing pairs. IMPORTANT: three strictly separated vertical columns with NO OVERLAP IN X: every pixel of the wingless fairy must stay within x=3%-28%; all pixels of large wing pair within x=37%-61%; all pixels of smaller wing pair within x=71%-95%. Empty full-height transparent gutters x28%-37% and61%-71%. Use a very wide canvas. Left: complete wingless fairy body, blonde hair pink flower, pink petal dress, bent legs and wand facing right. Center: complete turquoise/lilac butterfly wing pair, upper+lowerwing joined with a full root at lower right. Right: same complete slightly smaller wing pair with root at lower right. Match attached reference's exact friendly warm glossy cartoon style. No wings on fairy body, no body on wings, no ground shadow, text, labels or scenery. All pieces complete with wide transparent margins. Genuine alpha transparency.

Precise sprite-atlas correction. Keep this entire three-cell atlas EXACTLY unchanged in positions, scale, style, transparent background and arm drawings. Change ONLY the snowman BODY in the left cell: remove the blue circular shoulder socket/disc shapes completely, replacing them with smooth normal white snow shading and a continuous ordinary round snowman outline. No arm sockets, holes, cutouts, circles or blue patches on the body sides. Keep purple bunny-ear headband and ears, face, scarf, buttons and body silhouette unchanged. Keep BOTH separate brown stick arms in the middle and right cells unchanged with complete rounded roots. True transparent alpha outside these three objects, no new objects or shadows.
